newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ATHLETICS, DOPING-ROMANIAN ATHLETE ELENA MURGOCI BANNED FOR LIFE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS, DOPING-ROMANIAN ATHLETE ELENA MURGOCI BANNED FOR LIFE.

text.p: Romania's Athletics Federation (RAF) has banned distance runner athlete Elena Murgoci for life for taking anabolic steroids, its general secretary Traian Badea said on Saturday.
"Murgoci tested positive for the second time in recent years, so the ban was maximum," Badea said.
Murgoci, 32, a former champion half-marathon runner, used the banned drug Nandrolene, he added.
Badea said long jumper Marieta Ilcu and high jumper Monica Jager were also banned -- Ilcu for four years and Jager for six months for taking the same drug.
"Jager's six months ban is unusual for the athletics world, but she asked for more time to defend herself," Badea said. "And the Romanian Athletics Federation has agreed with this."
